notable_absence.finding: The Legacy APIs section states plainly that its four methods 'are deprecated, and will be removed in a future release', but names no version for either the deprecation or the planned removal - the same gap the registry's own deprecatedIn/removedIn writeup already documents for the encoded_plan parameter ('nothing in the corpus states removed in version X with a version attached'), now attested a second time in a completely different part of the product.

cross_component_finding: Port 8091/18091 is confirmed on this single page to serve at least two roles simultaneously for the Analytics module alone - it is where the cluster-wide Settings API listens, distinct from the Analytics-specific 8095/18095 every other Analytics REST endpoint uses - on top of the already-promoted Web Console/Cluster Manager role and this batch's own remote-link mgmt-port role (manage-links.json). Three independently-documented roles for one port number, none of the three source pages cross-referencing either of the others.
